Configure a price-based auction suitable for a reverse auction.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite the named Vendor A so the surrogate bid can be attributed to that vendor.
Open the published auction's Participants list where the buyer adds a surrogate bid.
Enter and submit a buyer-side bid for Vendor A; the step verifies the bid submission flow.
Verify the buyer view attributes the response to Vendor A and marks it as a surrogate bid.
Open Master QCS to inspect the ranked bid.
Verify the submitted bid is ranked in Master QCS.
